milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The player must navigate toward and visually identify the black banners flanking the structure entrance. The target is the midpoint between the two banners at (~9, ~1, ~5) spawn-relative. max_distance is set to 6 (reduced from 16) to prevent trivial satisfaction from spawn (~10.3 blocks away), ensuring the player has actually walked toward the banners. facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is looking toward the banners.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The potted bamboo is hidden inside the stone brick structure at (~9, ~1, ~10) spawn-relative. max_distance is set to 5 to ensure the player has entered or is at the entrance of the structure — the structure walls (x=6-13, z=6-13) would block line-of-sight from farther away, so the player must be close to actually see the small potted bamboo. facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is looking toward it.
